claimed_report.conclusion: The target (number of DEGs between low-temperature-stressed and control Hosta ventricosa plants, with up/down breakdown) cannot be reconstructed from the served inputs. The publication's method requires per-sample RNA-seq read counts: six cDNA libraries (3 NT, 3 LT) quantified with Salmon (TPM) and tested with edgeR at |log2FC|>1, P<0.05. The only deposited study input served is the assembled Trinity gene FASTA (GSE168396_Trinity.gene.fasta.gz, 64,848 gene records). No raw reads (FASTQ/SRA), no per-sample quantification, no count/TPM matrix, and no sample metadata are present, and there is no network access to retrieve them from GEO/SRA. Therefore the differential-expression computation cannot be executed and no observed value can be produced. The publication itself reports 12,059 DEGs (6,737 up-regulated, 5,322 down-regulated), but that is a comparison criterion, not a computed result.

claimed_report.conclusion: The target is the number of metabolites changing in abundance in the DSS group vs the CON group in positive ion mode, determined by volcano plot analysis of LC-MS-based untargeted fecal metabolomics. The publication (Section 3.7) reports 101 down-regulated plus 125 up-regulated metabolites in positive ion mode for DSS vs CON (Figure 10A), i.e. 226. However, the served inputs contain only 16S rRNA amplicon FASTQ files (full-length ~1.5 kb reads) for BioProject PRJNA1336462; no LC-MS raw or processed metabolomics data (mzML/mzXML/feature tables) are present, and no original implementation or processed result is available. The published method (LC-MS untargeted metabolomics with volcano plot analysis, |log2FC|>1, P<0.05) therefore cannot be executed on the served inputs, so no observed value can be computed. The publication's own reported figure is 226, but that is a comparison criterion, not a computed observation.
